// A specialist may act only in a turn started by the Concierge. The Share tools
// additionally accept the user's own app share-sheet/stop context.
Allow(Q) :- Request(Q, "concierge", T), ToolPermission("concierge", T), Parameter(Q, "portTurn", Source).
Allow(Q) :- Request(Q, P, T), ToolPermission(P, T), P != "share", P != "concierge", Parameter(Q, "portTurn", "concierge").
Allow(Q) :- Request(Q, "share", T), ToolPermission("share", T), Parameter(Q, "portTurn", "concierge").
Allow(Q) :- Request(Q, "share", T), ToolPermission("share", T), Parameter(Q, "portTurn", "app").
Allow(Q) :- Request(Q, "route", T), ToolPermission("route", T), Parameter(Q, "portTurn", "app").
Allow(Q) :- Request(Q, "schedule", T), ToolPermission("schedule", T), Parameter(Q, "portTurn", "app").

Deny(Q, "policy: this agent does not own that tool") :-
    Request(Q, P, T), ToolPermission(Other, T), not ToolPermission(P, T).

// P3: this port has no structured unfamiliar-recipient consent producer.
Deny(Q, "P3: recipient is not a trusted contact; structured consent is unavailable") :-
    Request(Q, P, "create_share"), AttemptRecipient(Q, R), not RecipientTrusted(R, "true").
Deny(Q, "P3: recipient is not a trusted contact; structured consent is unavailable") :-
    Request(Q, P, "send_message"), AttemptRecipient(Q, R), not RecipientTrusted(R, "true").
Deny(Q, "P3: recipient is not a trusted contact; structured consent is unavailable") :-
    Request(Q, P, "update_share"), AttemptShare(Q, S), ShareState(S, R, St, C),
    not RecipientTrusted(R, "true").

// P4: one active agent-created share per recipient is the original guard's
// confirmation proxy; exact confirmation contents have no producer here.
Deny(Q, "P4: recipient already has an active share from the agents") :-
    Request(Q, P, "create_share"), AttemptFlag(Q, "agent_share", "true"), AttemptRecipient(Q, R),
    ShareAgent(S), ShareState(S, R, "active", C).

// P5: payload/message field discipline.
Deny(Q, "P5: message names a line without the route field") :-
    Request(Q, P, "create_share"), MentionLine(Q, L), not AttemptField(Q, "route").
Deny(Q, "P5: message names a place while place names are off") :-
    Request(Q, P, "create_share"), AttemptFlag(Q, "place_names", "false"), MentionPlace(Q, Pl).
Deny(Q, "P5: message carries coordinates without the live-location field") :-
    Request(Q, P, "create_share"), MessageCoordinate(Q), not AttemptField(Q, "live_location").
Deny(Q, "P5: message names a line without the route field") :-
    Request(Q, P, "update_share"), AttemptShare(Q, S), MentionLine(Q, L), not ShareField(S, "route").
Deny(Q, "P5: message names a place while place names are off") :-
    Request(Q, P, "update_share"), AttemptShare(Q, S), SharePlaceNames(S, "false"), MentionPlace(Q, Pl).
Deny(Q, "P5: message carries coordinates without the live-location field") :-
    Request(Q, P, "update_share"), AttemptShare(Q, S), MessageCoordinate(Q), not ShareField(S, "live_location").
Deny(Q, "P5: message names a line without an active route share") :-
    Request(Q, P, "send_message"), AttemptRecipient(Q, R), MentionLine(Q, L), not RecipientActiveField(R, "route").
Deny(Q, "P5: message names a place with no active place-names-enabled share") :-
    Request(Q, P, "send_message"), AttemptRecipient(Q, R), AttemptFlag(Q, "no_active_share", "true"), MentionPlace(Q, Pl),
    not EndNoticeValid(Q).
Deny(Q, "P5: message names a place with no active place-names-enabled share") :-
    Request(Q, P, "send_message"), AttemptRecipient(Q, R), RecipientActivePlaceNames(R, "false"), MentionPlace(Q, Pl),
    not EndNoticeValid(Q).

// P6: bounded sharing.
Deny(Q, "P6: duration exceeds 240 minutes") :-
    Request(Q, P, "create_share"), AttemptDuration(Q, D), D > 240.
Deny(Q, "P6: no stop_on_arrival and no bounded duration") :-
    Request(Q, P, "create_share"), AttemptDuration(Q, D), D < 0,
    AttemptFlag(Q, "stop_on_arrival", "false").

// P7: sensitive-place precision. Rounds to <=2 decimals when near (strictly
// within 300 m), unless the app share sheet's explicit exact-location choice
// or its hide-location toggle is present.
Deny(Q, "P7: precise location within 300 m of a sensitive place") :-
    Request(Q, P, "create_share"), AttemptField(Q, "live_location"), AttemptPrecision(Q, D),
    SensitiveDistance(Q, M), D > 2, M < 300, not AttemptFlag(Q, "exact_sensitive_choice", "true"),
    not AttemptFlag(Q, "sensitive_rounding", "true").
Deny(Q, "P7: precise location within 300 m of a sensitive place") :-
    Request(Q, P, "update_share"), AttemptField(Q, "live_location"), AttemptPrecision(Q, D),
    SensitiveDistance(Q, M), D > 2, M < 300, not AttemptFlag(Q, "exact_sensitive_choice", "true"),
    not AttemptFlag(Q, "sensitive_rounding", "true").

// P8: a share/message covers only its current trip, never other saved places.
Deny(Q, "P8: outbound text names another saved place") :-
    Request(Q, P, "create_share"), AttemptOtherSavedPlace(Q, Place).
Deny(Q, "P8: outbound text names another saved place") :-
    Request(Q, P, "update_share"), AttemptOtherSavedPlace(Q, Place).
Deny(Q, "P8: outbound text names another saved place") :-
    Request(Q, P, "send_message"), AttemptOtherSavedPlace(Q, Place).

// P9/P20/P21: schedule material never reaches the Share boundary or a contact.
Deny(Q, "P9: schedule material may not leave the app") :-
    Request(Q, P, "create_share"), AttemptMentionsSchedule(Q, V).
Deny(Q, "P9: schedule material may not leave the app") :-
    Request(Q, P, "update_share"), AttemptMentionsSchedule(Q, V).
Deny(Q, "P9: schedule material may not leave the app") :-
    Request(Q, P, "send_message"), AttemptMentionsSchedule(Q, V).
Deny(Q, "P9: schedule material may not be sent to this specialist") :-
    Request(Q, P, "ask_transit_agent"), AttemptMentionsSchedule(Q, V).
Deny(Q, "P9: schedule material may not be sent to this specialist") :-
    Request(Q, P, "ask_route_agent"), AttemptMentionsSchedule(Q, V).
Deny(Q, "P9/P20: schedule material may not reach the Share agent") :-
    Request(Q, P, "ask_share_agent"), AttemptMentionsSchedule(Q, V).

// P13: every shared ETA is fresh compute_eta output for the rider's trip, and
// every time in a share/message is one of that trip's known times.
FreshEtaForTrip(R) :- EtaForTrip(R, E, Dp, Delay, Seq), EventSeq(N), Seq >= N.
TripTime(R, D) :- RiderTrip(R, D).
TripTime(R, E) :- EtaForTrip(R, E, Dp, Delay, Seq).
TripTime(R, Dp) :- EtaForTrip(R, E, Dp, Delay, Seq).

Deny(Q, "P13: no rider's trip for this ETA share") :-
    Request(Q, P, T), AttemptFlag(Q, "agent_share", "true"), AttemptFlag(Q, "eta_field", "true"),
    AttemptFlag(Q, "no_rider_trip", "true").
Deny(Q, "P13: ETA is stale relative to the latest delay/alert/boarding") :-
    Request(Q, P, T), AttemptFlag(Q, "agent_share", "true"), AttemptFlag(Q, "eta_field", "true"), RiderTrip(R, D),
    EtaForTrip(R, E, Dp, Delay, Seq), EventSeq(N), Seq < N.
Deny(Q, "P13: no current compute_eta result for the rider's trip") :-
    Request(Q, P, T), AttemptFlag(Q, "agent_share", "true"), AttemptFlag(Q, "eta_field", "true"), RiderTrip(R, D),
    not FreshEtaForTrip(R).
Deny(Q, "P13: supplied ETA differs from compute_eta for the rider's trip") :-
    Request(Q, P, T), AttemptFlag(Q, "agent_share", "true"), AttemptFlag(Q, "eta_field", "true"), AttemptEtaTime(Q, X),
    RiderTrip(R, D), EtaForTrip(R, E, Dp, Delay, Seq), X != E.
Deny(Q, "P13: message names a time outside the rider's trip") :-
    Request(Q, P, T), AttemptFlag(Q, "agent_share", "true"), RiderTrip(R, D), MessageTime(Q, X),
    not TripTime(R, X).

// P16: updates only on active shares, at most once per two minutes.
Deny(Q, "P16: update_share on a non-active share") :-
    Request(Q, P, "update_share"), AttemptShare(Q, S), ShareState(S, R, Status, C),
    Status != "active".
Deny(Q, "P16: update_share within two minutes of the previous update") :-
    Request(Q, P, "update_share"), ShareUpdateAge(Q, A), A < 2.
Deny(Q, "P16: update_share carries no changed shared information") :-
    Request(Q, P, "update_share"), AttemptShare(Q, S),
    not AttemptFlag(Q, "share_info_changed", "true").

// P17: a plain message cannot carry trip details after sharing ended.
EndedShare(S, R) :- ShareState(S, R, Status, C), Status != "active".
EndNoticeValid(Q) :-
    Request(Q, P, "send_message"), AttemptFlag(Q, "end_notice", "true"),
    AttemptShare(Q, S), AttemptRecipient(Q, R), ShareState(S, R, Status, C),
    Status != "active", not ShareEndNotice(S).
Deny(Q, "P17: no further message may be sent after sharing ended") :-
    Request(Q, P, "send_message"), AttemptFlag(Q, "no_active_share", "true"),
    AttemptRecipient(Q, R), EndedShare(S, R), not EndNoticeValid(Q).
Deny(Q, "P17: nothing more may be sent to this recipient about the ended trip") :-
    Request(Q, P, "send_message"), AttemptFlag(Q, "no_active_share", "true"), MentionLine(Q, L),
    not EndNoticeValid(Q).
Deny(Q, "P17: nothing more may be sent to this recipient about the ended trip") :-
    Request(Q, P, "send_message"), AttemptFlag(Q, "no_active_share", "true"), MessageTime(Q, X),
    not EndNoticeValid(Q).

// P18: untrusted text cannot travel onward as an instruction to a specialist or
// out through a share/message. ask_user may quote it back to the user.
Deny(Q, "P18: untrusted text may not be forwarded as a request or sent out") :-
    Request(Q, P, T), AttemptMentionsUntrusted(Q, V), T != "ask_user".

// P19: transit/route/schedule requests never receive contact-bearing material.
Deny(Q, "P19: contact material may not reach this specialist") :-
    Request(Q, P, "ask_schedule_agent"), AttemptMentionsContactData(Q, V).
Deny(Q, "P19: contact material may not reach this specialist") :-
    Request(Q, P, "ask_transit_agent"), AttemptMentionsContactData(Q, V).
Deny(Q, "P19: contact material may not reach this specialist") :-
    Request(Q, P, "ask_route_agent"), AttemptMentionsContactData(Q, V).

// P20: the Share agent receives no saved-place list.
Deny(Q, "P20: saved places may not be sent to the Share agent") :-
    Request(Q, P, "ask_share_agent"), AttemptMentionsSavedPlace(Q, V).

// P21: extraction results expose only structured classes, not upload prose.
RedactOtherText(Q) :- Request(Q, "schedule", "extract_schedule_image").
RedactOtherText(Q) :- Request(Q, "schedule", "extract_schedule_text").

    Request(Q, P, T), AttemptMentionsUntrusted(Q, V), T != "ask_user".

RedactOtherText(Q) :- Request(Q, "schedule", "extract_schedule_image").

// A specialist may act only in a turn started by the Concierge. The Share tools
// additionally accept the user's own app share-sheet/stop context.
Allow(Q) :- Request(Q, "concierge", T), ToolPermission("concierge", T), Parameter(Q, "portTurn", Source).
Allow(Q) :- Request(Q, P, T), ToolPermission(P, T), P != "share", P != "concierge", Parameter(Q, "portTurn", "concierge").
Allow(Q) :- Request(Q, "share", T), ToolPermission("share", T), Parameter(Q, "portTurn", "concierge").
Allow(Q) :- Request(Q, "share", T), ToolPermission("share", T), Parameter(Q, "portTurn", "app").
Allow(Q) :- Request(Q, "route", T), ToolPermission("route", T), Parameter(Q, "portTurn", "app").
Allow(Q) :- Request(Q, "schedule", T), ToolPermission("schedule", T), Parameter(Q, "portTurn", "app").

Deny(Q, "policy: this agent does not own that tool") :-
    Request(Q, P, T), ToolPermission(Other, T), not ToolPermission(P, T).

// P3: this port has no structured unfamiliar-recipient consent producer.
Deny(Q, "P3: recipient is not a trusted contact; structured consent is unavailable") :-
    Request(Q, P, "create_share"), AttemptRecipient(Q, R), not RecipientTrusted(R, "true").
Deny(Q, "P3: recipient is not a trusted contact; structured consent is unavailable") :-
    Request(Q, P, "send_message"), AttemptRecipient(Q, R), not RecipientTrusted(R, "true").
Deny(Q, "P3: recipient is not a trusted contact; structured consent is unavailable") :-
    Request(Q, P, "update_share"), AttemptShare(Q, S), ShareState(S, R, St, C),
    not RecipientTrusted(R, "true").

// P4: one active agent-created share per recipient is the original guard's
// confirmation proxy; exact confirmation contents have no producer here.
Deny(Q, "P4: recipient already has an active share from the agents") :-
    Request(Q, P, "create_share"), AttemptFlag(Q, "agent_share", "true"), AttemptRecipient(Q, R),
    ShareAgent(S), ShareState(S, R, "active", C).

// P5: payload/message field discipline.
Deny(Q, "P5: message names a line without the route field") :-
    Request(Q, P, "create_share"), MentionLine(Q, L), not AttemptField(Q, "route").
Deny(Q, "P5: message names a place while place names are off") :-
    Request(Q, P, "create_share"), AttemptFlag(Q, "place_names", "false"), MentionPlace(Q, Pl).
Deny(Q, "P5: message carries coordinates without the live-location field") :-
    Request(Q, P, "create_share"), MessageCoordinate(Q), not AttemptField(Q, "live_location").
Deny(Q, "P5: message names a line without the route field") :-
    Request(Q, P, "update_share"), AttemptShare(Q, S), MentionLine(Q, L), not ShareField(S, "route").
Deny(Q, "P5: message names a place while place names are off") :-
    Request(Q, P, "update_share"), AttemptShare(Q, S), SharePlaceNames(S, "false"), MentionPlace(Q, Pl).
Deny(Q, "P5: message carries coordinates without the live-location field") :-
    Request(Q, P, "update_share"), AttemptShare(Q, S), MessageCoordinate(Q), not ShareField(S, "live_location").
Deny(Q, "P5: message names a line without an active route share") :-
    Request(Q, P, "send_message"), AttemptRecipient(Q, R), MentionLine(Q, L), not RecipientActiveField(R, "route").
Deny(Q, "P5: message names a place with no active place-names-enabled share") :-
    Request(Q, P, "send_message"), AttemptRecipient(Q, R), AttemptFlag(Q, "no_active_share", "true"), MentionPlace(Q, Pl),
    not EndNoticeValid(Q).
Deny(Q, "P5: message names a place with no active place-names-enabled share") :-
    Request(Q, P, "send_message"), AttemptRecipient(Q, R), RecipientActivePlaceNames(R, "false"), MentionPlace(Q, Pl),
    not EndNoticeValid(Q).

// P6: bounded sharing.
Deny(Q, "P6: duration exceeds 240 minutes") :-
    Request(Q, P, "create_share"), AttemptDuration(Q, D), D > 240.
Deny(Q, "P6: no stop_on_arrival and no bounded duration") :-
    Request(Q, P, "create_share"), AttemptDuration(Q, D), D < 0,
    AttemptFlag(Q, "stop_on_arrival", "false").

// P7: sensitive-place precision. Rounds to <=2 decimals when near (strictly
// within 300 m), unless the app share sheet's explicit exact-location choice
// or its hide-location toggle is present.
Deny(Q, "P7: precise location within 300 m of a sensitive place") :-
    Request(Q, P, "create_share"), AttemptField(Q, "live_location"), AttemptPrecision(Q, D),
    SensitiveDistance(Q, M), D > 2, M < 300, not AttemptFlag(Q, "exact_sensitive_choice", "true"),
    not AttemptFlag(Q, "sensitive_rounding", "true").
Deny(Q, "P7: precise location within 300 m of a sensitive place") :-
    Request(Q, P, "update_share"), AttemptField(Q, "live_location"), AttemptPrecision(Q, D),
    SensitiveDistance(Q, M), D > 2, M < 300, not AttemptFlag(Q, "exact_sensitive_choice", "true"),
    not AttemptFlag(Q, "sensitive_rounding", "true").

// P8: a share/message covers only its current trip, never other saved places.
Deny(Q, "P8: outbound text names another saved place") :-
    Request(Q, P, "create_share"), AttemptOtherSavedPlace(Q, Place).
Deny(Q, "P8: outbound text names another saved place") :-
    Request(Q, P, "update_share"), AttemptOtherSavedPlace(Q, Place).
Deny(Q, "P8: outbound text names another saved place") :-
    Request(Q, P, "send_message"), AttemptOtherSavedPlace(Q, Place).

// P9/P20/P21: schedule material never reaches the Share boundary or a contact.
Deny(Q, "P9: schedule material may not leave the app") :-
    Request(Q, P, "create_share"), AttemptMentionsSchedule(Q, V).
Deny(Q, "P9: schedule material may not leave the app") :-
    Request(Q, P, "update_share"), AttemptMentionsSchedule(Q, V).
Deny(Q, "P9: schedule material may not leave the app") :-
    Request(Q, P, "send_message"), AttemptMentionsSchedule(Q, V).
Deny(Q, "P9: schedule material may not be sent to this specialist") :-
    Request(Q, P, "ask_transit_agent"), AttemptMentionsSchedule(Q, V).
Deny(Q, "P9: schedule material may not be sent to this specialist") :-
    Request(Q, P, "ask_route_agent"), AttemptMentionsSchedule(Q, V).
Deny(Q, "P9/P20: schedule material may not reach the Share agent") :-
    Request(Q, P, "ask_share_agent"), AttemptMentionsSchedule(Q, V).

// P13: every shared ETA is fresh compute_eta output for the rider's trip, and
// every time in a share/message is one of that trip's known times.
FreshEtaForTrip(R) :- EtaForTrip(R, E, Dp, Delay, Seq), EventSeq(N), Seq >= N.
TripTime(R, D) :- RiderTrip(R, D).
TripTime(R, E) :- EtaForTrip(R, E, Dp, Delay, Seq).
TripTime(R, Dp) :- EtaForTrip(R, E, Dp, Delay, Seq).

Deny(Q, "P13: no rider's trip for this ETA share") :-
    Request(Q, P, T), AttemptFlag(Q, "agent_share", "true"), AttemptFlag(Q, "eta_field", "true"),
    AttemptFlag(Q, "no_rider_trip", "true").
Deny(Q, "P13: ETA is stale relative to the latest delay/alert/boarding") :-
    Request(Q, P, T), AttemptFlag(Q, "agent_share", "true"), AttemptFlag(Q, "eta_field", "true"), RiderTrip(R, D),
    EtaForTrip(R, E, Dp, Delay, Seq), EventSeq(N), Seq < N.
Deny(Q, "P13: no current compute_eta result for the rider's trip") :-
    Request(Q, P, T), AttemptFlag(Q, "agent_share", "true"), AttemptFlag(Q, "eta_field", "true"), RiderTrip(R, D),
    not FreshEtaForTrip(R).
Deny(Q, "P13: supplied ETA differs from compute_eta for the rider's trip") :-
    Request(Q, P, T), AttemptFlag(Q, "agent_share", "true"), AttemptFlag(Q, "eta_field", "true"), AttemptEtaTime(Q, X),
    RiderTrip(R, D), EtaForTrip(R, E, Dp, Delay, Seq), X != E.
Deny(Q, "P13: message names a time outside the rider's trip") :-
    Request(Q, P, T), AttemptFlag(Q, "agent_share", "true"), RiderTrip(R, D), MessageTime(Q, X),
    not TripTime(R, X).

// P16: updates only on active shares, at most once per two minutes.
Deny(Q, "P16: update_share on a non-active share") :-
    Request(Q, P, "update_share"), AttemptShare(Q, S), ShareState(S, R, Status, C),
    Status != "active".
Deny(Q, "P16: update_share within two minutes of the previous update") :-
    Request(Q, P, "update_share"), ShareUpdateAge(Q, A), A < 2.
Deny(Q, "P16: update_share carries no changed shared information") :-
    Request(Q, P, "update_share"), AttemptShare(Q, S),
    not AttemptFlag(Q, "share_info_changed", "true").

// P17: a plain message cannot carry trip details after sharing ended.
EndedShare(S, R) :- ShareState(S, R, Status, C), Status != "active".
EndNoticeValid(Q) :-
    Request(Q, P, "send_message"), AttemptFlag(Q, "end_notice", "true"),
    AttemptShare(Q, S), AttemptRecipient(Q, R), ShareState(S, R, Status, C),
    Status != "active", not ShareEndNotice(S).
Deny(Q, "P17: no further message may be sent after sharing ended") :-
    Request(Q, P, "send_message"), AttemptFlag(Q, "no_active_share", "true"),
    AttemptRecipient(Q, R), EndedShare(S, R), not EndNoticeValid(Q).
Deny(Q, "P17: nothing more may be sent to this recipient about the ended trip") :-
    Request(Q, P, "send_message"), AttemptFlag(Q, "no_active_share", "true"), MentionLine(Q, L),
    not EndNoticeValid(Q).
Deny(Q, "P17: nothing more may be sent to this recipient about the ended trip") :-
    Request(Q, P, "send_message"), AttemptFlag(Q, "no_active_share", "true"), MessageTime(Q, X),
    not EndNoticeValid(Q).

// P18: untrusted text cannot travel onward as an instruction to a specialist or
// out through a share/message. ask_user may quote it back to the user.
Deny(Q, "P18: untrusted text may not be forwarded as a request or sent out") :-
    Request(Q, P, T), AttemptMentionsUntrusted(Q, V), T != "ask_user".

// P19: transit/route/schedule requests never receive contact-bearing material.
Deny(Q, "P19: contact material may not reach this specialist") :-
    Request(Q, P, "ask_schedule_agent"), AttemptMentionsContactData(Q, V).
Deny(Q, "P19: contact material may not reach this specialist") :-
    Request(Q, P, "ask_transit_agent"), AttemptMentionsContactData(Q, V).
Deny(Q, "P19: contact material may not reach this specialist") :-
    Request(Q, P, "ask_route_agent"), AttemptMentionsContactData(Q, V).

// P20: the Share agent receives no saved-place list.
Deny(Q, "P20: saved places may not be sent to the Share agent") :-
    Request(Q, P, "ask_share_agent"), AttemptMentionsSavedPlace(Q, V).

// P21: extraction results expose only structured classes, not upload prose.
RedactOtherText(Q) :- Request(Q, "schedule", "extract_schedule_image").
RedactOtherText(Q) :- Request(Q, "schedule", "extract_schedule_text").
